prompt: Complete the parseOrDefault method: return Integer.parseInt(text), but catch NumberFormatException and return the fallback value when the text cannot be parsed.
explanation: Integer.parseInt throws a NumberFormatException for any input it cannot convert, including letters, decimals, strings with spaces, the empty string, and even null. Wrapping the call in a try block and catching that specific exception turns a crash into a controlled fallback value. Catching the narrow NumberFormatException (rather than Exception) is good practice because it only handles the failure you expect.
hints: Put the return Integer.parseInt(text); call inside a try block.
Add catch (NumberFormatException e) after the try block and return fallback there.
You do not need a special null check: Integer.parseInt(null) also throws NumberFormatException, so the same catch handles it.
